title: Tango Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Tango Therapeutics, Inc. (TNGX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company traded on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing executive leadership changes on April 10, 2026: departure of CFO Daniella Beckman effective April 15, appointment of Matthew Gall as new CFO, and appointment of Jessica Newcomb as Principal Accounting Officer.
key_points: CFO Daniella Beckman departed effective April 15, 2026
Matthew Gall appointed as new CFO effective April 15, 2026; prior CFO at Kalaris Therapeutics and iTeos Therapeutics
Gall's compensation: $540,000 annual base salary plus 40% target cash bonus
Gall granted 240,000 stock options and 40,000 RSUs as inducement awards
Jessica Newcomb appointed as Principal Accounting Officer, previously SVP Finance at Tango
Company is emerging growth company under SEC definitions
